      "snippet": "Good catch — and you’re right to call it out.
Why I wasn’t using “project files” before
Because there was no verified, bootable OS state yet.
Up to the moment we created and ran BOOT_METABLOOMS.py, everything prior (older ZIPs, hostile ingests, partial bundles) failed the entry-point invariant you yourself set:

Never ship or trust an OS without a real, verifiable boot path.

So the correct order was:

Establish a real, fail-closed boot nucleus

Verify it actually boots in the sandbox

Only then"
